summary: GPU-unlock is a command‑line utility (with a Python API) that measures FP32 and BF16 instruction issue rates on Nvidia RTX 30‑series GPUs. It runs locally, built in C, and does not require any external API keys. Developers debugging LLM training performance on these GPUs would use it to pinpoint bottlenecks. It enjoys strong community interest (5,082 stars) but its limited test coverage (1/5 passed) and lack of packaging hinder immediate adoption.
